title: Versioned Skill lifecycle + refinement
objective: Make learned Skills inspectable and safely improvable through immutable revisions, evaluation comparison, explicit promotion and rollback instead of destructive or opaque mutation.
constraints: candidate revisions are immutable evidence snapshots
active revision must be explicit and rollback-capable
existing Site Skill candidate storage must remain readable/migratable
successful and failed runs may become refinement evidence but never opaque self-modification
manual-handoff preconditions must never be silently compiled away
SK-BROWSER-001 cross-runtime evaluation remains a parallel real-runtime blocker
deliverables: immutable revision history with parent links
refinement candidates derived from inspectable execution evidence
next_action: Implement the versioned Site Skill store first: immutable revision records, legacy v1 migration/read, latest/history lookup and active_revision_id data model without enabling promotion yet.
